**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Claude & other AI apps
- **New Settings tab: Claude & AI Apps.** Connecting Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Codex now has its own place in Settings instead of sitting under Meetings. Each app gets a **Connect** button: pick the folder once and WhisperShortcut adds itself to that app's setup, keeps everything else in it, and saves a backup first. "Set up by hand" is still there.
- **AI apps can now change every setting, not only prompts.** Ask Claude to switch your dictation or chat model, change a shortcut or turn a feature on or off, and it can do it for you. Up to 20 changes at once, all or nothing, and one Undo in the Claude & AI Apps tab reverts the whole batch.

## Dictate Prompt
- **Your own quick prompts.** Settings → Dictate Prompt → Quick Prompts: add up to 9 prompts of your own, reorder them, and fire them with ⌃1–9 while you dictate a prompt. "Start from Current List" fills it from today's suggestions. Prompts you use often are still listed below yours unless you switch that off.

## Dictation quality
- **Lossless audio uploads.** Recordings sent to Gemini and OpenRouter are now uploaded as lossless FLAC instead of compressed AAC. In a test on real dictations, the compressed audio changed the meaning of some sentences; FLAC came back word for word identical to the original recording.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.62...v8.63
